CVS Health downgrade OR guidance cut OR bankruptcy 2026

findings.claim: CVS Health 為最大客戶，占 FY2026 營收 28%、期末應收帳款毛額 22%；前五大客戶合計占營收 43%；10-K 自述銷售與信用集中度顯著，若主要客戶減少採購、違約或不續約，營運與財務可能受不利影響。
findings.excerpt: Our largest customer, CVS Health, accounted for 28 percent of our fiscal 2026 revenue. In the aggregate, our five largest customers, including CVS Health, accounted for 43 percent of our fiscal 2026 revenue.

findings.claim: CVS 10-Q（截至 2026-09-30）：長期債信評等 Fitch BBB 展望負面、Moody's Baa3 展望 2026-08 由穩定升為正面、S&P BBB 展望 2026-05 由負面轉穩定，仍屬投資等級。
findings.excerpt: As of September 30, 2026, the Company’s long-term debt was rated “BBB” by Fitch Ratings, Inc. (“Fitch”), “Baa3” by Moody’s Ratings (“Moody’s”) and “BBB” by Standard & Poor’s Financial Services LLC (“S&P”), and its commercial paper program was rated “F2” by Fitch, “P-3” by Moody’s and “A-2”

customer_concentration_credit.note: CVS 信用狀況（搜尋摘要，未取得逐字原文）：債信維持投資等級 BBB/Baa3；Fitch BBB 展望負面、Moody's Baa3 2026-08 展望由穩定升正面、S&P BBB 2026-05 展望由負面轉穩定；2026-02 CVS 維持 EPS 指引 7.00–7.20 美元但營運現金流目標由 10 億降至至少 9.0 十億美元；Omnicare 子公司破產與 CVS 母公司無關。未見母公司降評或破產。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
